invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.8.0 preserves the locked 2.7 recurring engine and deepens payment reminders into staged dunning: company-scoped policies and ordered stages, migrated legacy reminder thresholds, default policy seeding for fresh workspaces, invoice/customer reminder pause-disable controls, per-channel claim/send/fail state, bounded retries with retry scheduling, manual reminder audit entries, dedicated operator history and retry controls, and first-class dunning/reminder module resources. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, visibility, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
